description: This file 'lu5_fs.h' defines functions and macros related to file system operations, including file existence checks, name manipulation, and I/O operations. It provides an interface for opening, reading, and writing files, with some functions designed to handle errors and memory management.

methods.name: lu5_name_without_extention
methods.description: Removes the file extension from a filename and returns a newly allocated string without it.

methods.name: lu5_open_file
methods.description: Opens a file with the specified mode, handling possible errors during the operation.

methods.name: lu5_write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a file at the given path, with the specified buffer and length.

methods.name: lu5_read_file
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a buffer which must be freed by the caller; returns the buffer and sets the size.
